canonical_project: Latos Stockton / Preston Farm neural edge AI data centre

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Latos announced planning approval for a GBP100m neural-edge AI data centre at Preston Farm Industrial Estate, Stockton-on-Tees. Public reports describe two data halls totaling about 1,750 sqm and expected opening in early 2027; no MW capacity figure found.
